## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Mixed signals: Financials, Industrials and Materials are ABOVE TREND (C (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +21.94%) ABOVE TREND; FCX (1W: +8.57% | 1M: +27.29%) ABOVE TREND; BA (1W: +5.73% | 1M: +21.80%) ABOVE TREND) while multiple large-cap Tech names show RECOVERY (ORCL (1W: +10.66% | 1M: -1.39%) RECOVERY; GOOGL (1W: +5.85% | 1M: -1.34%) RECOVERY), and leadership is concentrated: Narrow (3/5 Technology).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Financials lead: C (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +21.94%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +4.51% | 1M: +10.46%) ABOVE TREND. Materials strong: FCX (1W: +8.57% | 1M: +27.29%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials robust: GE (1W: +8.41% | 1M: +7.72%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +5.73% | 1M: +21.80%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Energy lagging: XOM (1W: +1.54% | 1M: +2.80%) ABOVE TREND but sector weak; Energy overall at risk. Consumer Staples weak: PG (1W: -2.25% | 1M: -1.69%) BELOW TREND, PEP (1W: -4.22% | 1M: -0.24%) BELOW TREND. Utilities weak: sector negative.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: ORCL (1W: +10.66% | 1M: -1.39%) RECOVERY, NVDA (1W: +10.34% | 1M: +3.33%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +21.94%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +8.57% | 1M: +27.29%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +8.55% | 1M: +0.00%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: PG (1W: -2.25% | 1M: -1.69%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -2.48% | 1M: -6.48%) BELOW TREND, HD (1W: -2.64% | 1M: +3.86%) CORRECTION, PSX (1W: -2.71% | 1M: -3.60%) BELOW TREND, DE (1W: -2.82% | 1M: -4.06%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in staples and select industrial names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W momentum: ORCL (1W: +10.66% | 1M: -1.39%) RECOVERY, NVDA (1W: +10.34% | 1M: +3.33%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +21.94%) ABOVE TREND — note major divergence: ≥3 large caps (ORCL, AVGO, GOOGL) show 1W up vs 1M down, flagging tactical reversal risk.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed with RECOVERY signatures in several mega-cap names: NVDA (1W: +10.34% | 1M: +3.33%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +2.50% | 1M: +2.96%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +10.66% | 1M: -1.39%) RECOVERY, GOOGL (1W: +5.85% | 1M: -1.34%) RECOVERY; Tech: 12/19 positive.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials are clear leaders and bullish on cycle exposure: C (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +21.94%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +4.51% | 1M: +10.46%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +3.12% | 1M: +7.85%) ABOVE TREND; Financials: 13/20 positive.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Patchy: MRK (1W: +7.33% | 1M: +6.93%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +3.38% | 1M: +0.64%) ABOVE TREND offset by JNJ (1W: -1.21% | 1M: +1.48%) CORRECTION and PFE (1W: -0.04% | 1M: -0.75%) BELOW TREND; Healthcare: 9/15 positive.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor cyclicals and Financials given clear ABOVE TREND signals in C, JPM and Industrials like BA and GE; reduce exposure to names showing RECOVERY-driven reversals in Tech (ORCL (1W: +10.66% | 1M: -1.39%) RECOVERY, GOOGL (1W: +5.85% | 1M: -1.34%) RECOVERY) until follow-through confirms. Style: Mixed with a slight Value/Cyclical tilt.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: NVDA (1W: +10.34% | 1M: +3.33%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +21.94%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +8.57% | 1M: +27.29%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ORCL (1W: +10.66% | 1M: -1.39%) RECOVERY (watch for failure), PFE (1W: -0.04% | 1M: -0.75%) BELOW TREND, PG (1W: -2.25% | 1M: -1.69%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Financials (13/20 positive), Materials (6/7 positive), Industrials (9/13 positive). BEARISH: Energy (2/8 positive), Consumer Staples (3/11 positive), Utilities (1/6 positive).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA: sustain this week’s breakout to confirm ABOVE TREND continuation; ORCL: failure to hold this week’s gains signals reversion from RECOVERY; JPM/C: continued breadth-led follow-through confirms Financials leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
NVDA (+50): Nvidia licensing deal headline aligns with price action — NVDA (1W: +10.34% | 1M: +3.33%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirms accumulation. BA (+50): contract headlines alongside strong 1W — BA (1W: +5.73% | 1M: +21.80%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirming. KHC (+55): CEO/breakup talk but price lagging — KHC (1W: -2.95% | 1M: -3.28%) BELOW TREND — sentiment not yet confirmed by price.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
PFE (-65): trial/death headline and guidance concerns align with weakness — PFE (1W: -0.04% | 1M: -0.75%) BELOW TREND — confirmed. ORCL (-45): AI-bubble fears in headlines but stock rallied this week — ORCL (1W: +10.66% | 1M: -1.39%) RECOVERY — divergence (distribution risk). META (-45): regulatory headline vs. price strength — META (1W: +2.78% | 1M: +8.98%) ABOVE TREND — divergence to monitor.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with style mixed but a slight Value/Cyclicals tilt. NVDA (1W: +10.34% | 1M: +3.33%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +21.94%) ABOVE TREND and FCX (1W: +8.57% | 1M: +27.29%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence in large-cap Tech (≥3 names in RECOVERY) and negative headlines on ORCL/Meta creating distribution risk — watch for follow-through.
